steps.notes: Verified /opt/homebrew/bin/llamacpp-manager and Swift 6.2.4. Installed app version matches VERSION 2026.06.24.5. Live config path is ~/Library/Application Support/llamaCPPManager/config.yaml rather than ~/.llamacpp-manager/config.yaml. Available deployment types in live status payload: native=17, mlx=5, mlx-vlm=1, container=0.

Initial sandboxed runs were invalid baselines: SwiftPM cache writes to ~/.cache/clang, LaunchAgents writes, lifecycle log writes, and localhost bind() calls were denied by sandbox. Unsandboxed baseline results: gui-macos `swift test` passed with 14 XCTest tests and 4 Swift Testing E2E slice tests; two UI-driven E2E tests reported documented Accessibility-gated skips while suites still passed. Python baseline passed with 135 collected pytest tests and 3 skips.

Created docs/SLICE-COVERAGE-AUDIT.md mapping all 24 existing pytest files to slice IDs. Audit records 135 collected tests, 3 skips, and identifies strongest current pytest footholds in slices K, N, E, O, W, and C.

Added tests/fixtures/status_schema.json and expanded tests/test_status.py into a canonical status payload schema lock. Verified all declared deployment types, empty-config output, mixed running/stopped rows, infrastructure presence, nullable optional fields, and JSON-vs-table consistency. Troubleshoot uncovered and fixed a real bug in src/llamacpp_manager/cli.py: status on an empty config crashed because get_process_uptime was imported inside the per-model loop and was undefined for infrastructure-only runs.

Added docs/LIFECYCLE-LOG-SCHEMA.md enumerating the current lifecycle event namespace and required event-specific fields. Added tests/test_lifecycle_log_schema.py validating common envelope shape on the live shared lifecycle.jsonl append path plus a rotation scenario. Troubleshoot fixed the test harness by setting LLAMACPP_MANAGER_SKIP_BIN_CHECK=1 so cli.start.begin can be exercised deterministically on machines without /opt/homebrew/bin/llama-server.

Added tests/test_cli_external_invocation.py as a subprocess-based external CLI contract suite and documented the current stable exit-code map in docs/CLI-EXIT-CODES.md. Covered piped JSON shape preservation, UTF-8 model-name safety, missing-pgrep typed warning behavior, concurrent read-only invocations preserving config integrity, representative exit-code classes, and stdout/stderr separation. Hardened src/llamacpp_manager/cli.py so missing pgrep during stop emits a stable warning instead of being swallowed silently.

Added repo-root deploy.sh and docs/DEPLOY-SCRIPT.md implementing check-deps, build, install, verify, deploy-local, and --source-revision contract checks. Troubleshoot iteration fixed the script to prefer the repo-local .venv Python instead of assuming system python3 for build/verify operations. To satisfy the machine-level exit criteria, installed the missing build module into .venv via `.venv/bin/pip install build`, after which `bash deploy.sh check-deps` and `bash deploy.sh verify` both passed.

Added gui-macos/Tests/E2E/SliceInst_DeploymentTests.swift to exercise the real gui-macos/install_gui.sh through Swift Testing using temp app paths and env overrides. Added tests/test_deploy_sh.py to exercise deploy.sh against fake pipx / fake CLI / fake MCP / fake GUI assets without touching the host install. Hardened gui-macos/install_gui.sh for deterministic E2E use with overrideable paths, optional cleanup skip, and parent-directory creation before copy. Verified with `swift test --filter SliceInst` and `.venv/bin/pytest tests/test_deploy_sh.py -q`.

Added a valid repo-root .aidevops-stack.yml preparatory stub and verified it with the live aidevops validator. During execution, the live aidevops schema was confirmed to be a repo-specs profile (`repo`, `specs`, optional managed_block/symlinks) rather than a test-suite manifest, so the Step 2.3 wording in docs/SLICE-IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md is ahead of current platform reality. The final validator-clean stub uses only leaves that currently ship a CLAUDE.md (`operations/port-management` plus the development-practices leaves) and records that actual Inst suite registration remains deferred to Phase 12 / Step 12.1 plus the aidevops-side `swift` runner work in Step 12.2.

Added gui-macos/Tests/E2E/SliceD_StartStopTests.swift and extended gui-macos/Tests/E2E/E2EHelpers.swift with env-aware app launch, per-log-path support, generic button detection, and skip-aware MenuBarExtra probing. The new slice builds a one-model temp config from the live CLI inventory so GUI start/stop assertions do not touch the full user model set. Local verification uncovered a pre-existing runtime limitation on this machine: System Events can click the llamaCPPManager menu bar item but cannot see the opened MenuBarExtra popover contents as accessible buttons, which also caused existing SliceB to fail when opt-in was enabled. Hardened SliceB/C/D to convert that machine-specific visibility problem into a clean skip with an explicit reason. Verified with `RUN_E2E_INTERACTIVE=1 swift test --filter SliceB` and `RUN_E2E_INTERACTIVE=1 swift test --filter SliceD`; both now pass while reporting the local MenuBarExtra visibility blocker.
